## Illumina to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, October 29, 2026


October 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.illumina.com/node/29246/pdf)


SAN DIEGO


, Oct. 8, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Illumina, Inc. (NASDAQ: ILMN) announced today that it will issue results for the third quarter 2026 following the close of market on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


On the same day, at 1:30 pm Pacific Time (4:30 pm Eastern Time) Jacob Thaysen, PhD, Chief Executive Officer, and Ankur Dhingra, Chief Financial Officer, will host a conference call with analysts, investors, and other interested parties to discuss financial and operating results.


**Conference Call Details**


The conference call will begin at 1:30 pm Pacific Time (4:30 pm Eastern Time) on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Interested parties may access the live webcast via the Investor Info section of Illumina's website or directly through the following[link](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4792321-1&h=2700698864&u=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fillumina-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net%2F__%3B!!HrbR-XT-OQ!URi3jSQw-NMN3w0ImrI0oqR3n-3-R2VnuV67Gx-ZCC7v99RWMOaU_5Gs34HSHx2aI-XV87UnCstUoSNUgMt85vjx%24&a=link) –[https://illumina-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4792321-1&h=1187912295&u=https%3A%2F%2Fillumina-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fillumina-earnings-call-q3-2026.open-exchange.net) . To ensure a timely connection, please join at least ten minutes before the scheduled start of the call.


A replay of the conference call will be posted on Illumina's website after the event and will be available for at least 30 days following.


**About Illumina**


Illumina is improving human health by unlocking the power of the genome. Our focus on innovation has established us as a global leader in DNA sequencing and array-based technologies, serving customers in the research, clinical, and applied markets. Our products are used for applications in the life sciences, oncology, reproductive health, agriculture, and other emerging segments.
